name: 15a softmax walkthrough
title: Softmax turns four scores into probabilities that sum to one
subtitle: Section 5 example: context "the cat"; logits 2.0, 1.0, 0.5, -1.0; temperature divides every logit

steps.caption: The network ends with one raw score per vocabulary token, called a logit. Logits can be any real number, negative included, and they do not sum to anything in particular.
At temperature 1 the logits pass through unchanged. Temperature is a number that divides every logit before the next step.
Exponentiate each one: e to the 2.0 is 7.389, e to the -1.0 is 0.368. Every result is positive and the larger logit stays larger.
Divide each exponential by their sum 12.124. The probabilities are 0.609, 0.224, 0.136 and 0.030, and they sum to one.
Subtracting the largest logit from all four first gives the same probabilities, because the shared factor cancels in the division. Real code does this so e to a large logit never overflows.
Temperature 0.5 doubles every logit gap before exponentiating. "sat" rises to 0.842 and "the" falls to 0.002, so sampling becomes nearly deterministic.
Temperature 2 halves every gap. The distribution flattens to 0.434, 0.263, 0.205 and 0.097, so sampling picks the unlikely tokens more often.
